section_summary: This section consists of diplomatic correspondence and records from the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo spanning December 1940 to March 1941, centered on Ambassador Joseph C. Grew's comprehensive monthly report on conditions in Japan for December 1940 (Despatch No. 5321 / Report No. 1671). The report details escalating diplomatic friction between the United States and Japan, major policy addresses by Foreign Minister Yosuke Matsuoka and Ambassador Grew, infractions of American rights in China, British-Japanese tensions over German raiders, trade talks with Indochina and the Netherlands East Indies, and Japanese domestic restructuring under the Konoye Cabinet. The section also includes transmittal memoranda and monthly catalog lists of Embassy telegrams and despatches sent to the State Department for December 1940 and January 1941.

subfiles.about: Concluding pages of telegram index lists and the complete schedule of despatches sent from the Tokyo Embassy in December 1940.
subfiles.summary: This subfile contains the concluding pages (-6- and -7-) of the Embassy's telegram log for December 1940, covering telegrams Nos. 1370 through 1396 from December 24 to 31. It is followed by the complete chronological list of despatches Nos. 5182 through 5260 mailed during December 1940, cataloguing official reports on Japanese political, military, and commercial matters. Page 404 is a blank sheet separating the index list from the incoming monthly despatch.
subfiles.title: Lists of Telegrams and Despatches Sent to the Department of State, December 1940 (Partial)

subfiles.about: Comprehensive Embassy report analyzing political, foreign, military, and economic developments in Japan during December 1940.
subfiles.from: Joseph C. Grew, American Ambassador, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Joseph C. Grew transmits Report No. 1671 detailing conditions in Japan during December 1940. The report analyzes severe strains in U.S.-Japanese relations, highlighted by Foreign Minister Matsuoka's and Ambassador Grew's speeches before the America-Japan Society, official exchanges regarding Japanese infractions of American rights in China, and U.S. economic restrictions. Further sections evaluate Anglo-Japanese tensions, the Axis alliance, military campaigns in China, economic negotiations with French Indochina and the Netherlands East Indies, and domestic structural reforms under Prime Minister Konoye and Home Minister Hiranuma.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 5321: Report of Conditions in Japan During the Month of December 1940 (Report No. 1671)

subfiles.about: Complete chronological duplicate lists of telegrams and despatches dispatched by the Tokyo Embassy in December 1940.
subfiles.summary: This subfile provides a full duplicate listing of all official telegrams (Nos. 1252 to 1396) transmitted by the Tokyo Embassy to the State Department throughout December 1940. It also incorporates the full five-page catalog of official despatches Nos. 5182 to 5260 prepared by Embassy staff and consulates in the Japanese Empire during that month. The entries document protests over property damage, trade disputes, visa affairs, and political developments.
subfiles.title: Lists of Telegrams and Despatches Sent to the Department of State, December 1940 (Duplicate Copy)

subfiles.about: File room transmittal memorandum and monthly index lists of telegrams and despatches sent from Tokyo during January 1941.
subfiles.summary: An official transmittal memorandum dated March 14, 1941, requests that the enclosed monthly schedules be appended to Despatch No. 5372 of February 14, 1941 (Report of Conditions in Japan During January 1941). The enclosure includes a complete index of Embassy telegrams Nos. 1 through 151 sent to the Department during January 1941, documenting reactions to President Roosevelt's speeches, the reopening of the Imperial Diet, and Japanese mediation in the Thai-Indochina conflict. It concludes with the opening sheet of the despatch list for January 1941, covering despatches Nos. 5261 to 5274.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the File Room Transmitting Lists of Telegrams and Despatches for January 1941
subfiles.to: Division of Communications and Records, Department of State
